status: complete quality and sustained validation; measured development fingerprints retained
protocol: native coded-Y-v1; every third frame PSNR/SSIM, every frame VMAF/NEG; equal clip averages

selection_lock.status: locked before holdout preparation/evaluation; not a release pass

settings.color_boundary: preserve coded range/matrix on both raw encoder input and output

selection_lock.rationale: Unblended small improves all three development averages and secondary NEG versus bicubic. Scalar 0.5/0.75 reduce PSNR/SSIM/VMAF averages. Temporal diagnostic increases about 2.4%, no inspected severe artifact. Medium doubles model-only compute for modest preliminary quality gains; reserved for comparison. Avoid learned/adaptive fusion complexity without a demonstrated benefit.
required_next: evaluate all 12 holdout clips with these fixed settings

environment.processor: Snapdragon(R) X Plus - X1P42100 - Qualcomm(R) Oryon(TM) CPU

configuration.metric_protocol: native-Y-v1; clip PSNR from mean MSE; every-frame VMAF

preparation.color_matrix: BT709; assumed for untagged HD sources, recorded
preparation.downscale: FFmpeg scale 960x540, bicubic B=0 C=0.5, antialiasing
preparation.lr_codec: libx264 veryfast CRF10; explicit CRF26 stress cases
preparation.timing: retime original consecutive frames to 30 FPS; no intentional frame duplication
preparation.metrics: active predeclared ROI excludes fixed film letterbox; paired PSNR/SSIM/VMAF, secondary VMAF NEG, reference residual-change diagnostic
preparation.averaging: equal per-clip arithmetic means; also report by source/category and holdout separately
